nodes.verify: Run related checks and record the changed files and evidence.

nodes.description: Review the final diff against the Story, including failure paths.
nodes.verify: Record findings and evidence; fail with the corrective action if changes are needed.

nodes.verify: Record actual commands, exit codes, changed-file scope and unproven boundaries.

output.summary: Replanned after the Story change made in review 2 (D29 limit: discovery itself starts a blocked claude, so its hooks run once per discovery). Earlier run .ai-workflow/runs/U24-claude-stop-grace-hooks.json holds attempts 1-2 and review 1. Attempt 2 after review 1 (Changes needed). Important 1: qualify() refuses a blocked install before the cache lookup (RUNNER_NOT_READY) and Claw prequalify skips blocked installs. Important 2: claudeModels resolves {models, hooks:null} when the CLI answered the models but closed or hit the 15 s timer without a listing. Minor: blocked text deduplicated; claude-profile.ts comment notes SessionEnd never reaches the stream; remote-job budget test reaps at 17 s; docs refreshed (solutions doc distilled to 12 s/18 s and hook listing, STATUS, 10-28/10-29 records, D28/D29). RED: 4 new tests failed (blocked qualified; models-then-exit and models-then-silence not unknown; duplicate hook text); 3 coverage tests (listing first, malformed entry, discovery failure not judged) passed from the start. GREEN: runner-qualification+runner-models+runner-settings+claude-controller+remote-job 66/66; typecheck exit 0; full npm test 1104/1104 exit 0 (09:49-09:50, load ~5-15). Real check: loadRunnerCatalog on this Mac with claude 2.1.280: hooks [], not blocked, 5 models, 1.8 s. Follow-ups left: discovery's own 2 s SIGTERM->SIGKILL, launcher step-1 hook check.

Two independent report-only reviews. (1) Changes needed: Important 1 (qualify/prequalify ignored blocked) and 2 (models answered without a listing not blocked) plus Minor; all fixed in implement attempt 2. (2) Same reviewer on the fixes: code approved as is (5 files 66/66, typecheck exit 0; no race or double settle); docs-only Important: discovery itself still starts a blocked claude so its SessionStart/SessionEnd hooks run once per discovery (confirmed on real CLI 2.1.280 with an isolated config and a --settings hook; predates this change). Applied after review 2: qualify comment narrowed, limit added to D29, the 10-30 record and STATUS, solutions doc hedged and line refs fixed, remote-job table row, discovery-failure test given a fake codex. Follow-ups accepted as deferred: discovery's own 2 s SIGTERM->SIGKILL, launcher step-1 hook check.

Fresh verification after review 2 fixes (worktree codex/claude-stop-grace on codex/real-cli-check 5bbcb18): npm test 1104/1104 exit 0 (2026-10-30 09:56-09:57, load 4-7); typecheck exit 0; story check exit 0; affected 5 files 66/66. Changed product files: src/runners/claude-controller.ts, remote-job.ts, runner-models.ts, runner-qualification.ts, claude-profile.ts (comment), src/runtime/runner-settings.ts, live.ts. Real check: loadRunnerCatalog with this Mac claude 2.1.280 -> hooks [], not blocked. Unproven: a Mac with managed hooks; 12 s under real load (basis: 9.1 s max measured); whether server-delivered settings are merged at discovery time; discovery itself still runs a blocked claude and its hooks once per discovery.
